answer: Clone convoys cannot share one mooring pin. An applicant escrows 8.70 POA and draws a single reserved basalt pin on a quarantine quay for 16 minutes. They must lower a 14.6 kg etched anchor disk onto that pin, complete a 1.1 km sounding voyage to a marker buoy, and radio a 20-bit hash of pin-id plus pubkey in minutes 6-14. Peers verify one disk occupies the pin and the hash matches the ticket. If a second disk appears, the hash is late, or the voyage log is blank, half the bond is slashed and the pin is retired for 40 hours.
